text:
maria: Quick idea — stitch the launch posts, webinar cohort, and inbound routing into one micro-experiment for H1. Goal: push dev signups and measure 7-day active usage. Thinking we pair a short benchmark narrative with a starter-token distribution and two onboarding prompt templates. :rocket:
kevin: Love it. What's the concrete hypothesis?
sam: Hypothesis: narrative that frames runtimes + predictable cost (benchmark story) + an in-app starter token modal will drive higher activation than generic feature posts + email-only tokens.
maria: Exactly. Metric: 7-day active (>=1 API call + completed quickstart prompt). Secondary: webinar conversion and signal quality (lead-to-paid within 30d).
olivia: How are we routing inbound? We should avoid one-size-fits-all. Suggest tagging source + campaign in webhook and routing top intent leads to demo flow, others to self-serve.
maria: Proposed test cells (3x2):
- Launch post narrative A (benchmark: latency/cost) vs B (developer success story) vs C (product tour snippet)
- Token distribution: in-app modal (immediate) vs email drip (24h)
Plus split on onboarding prompt template 1 vs 2 within each cell.
kevin: That’s 6 combos. Need to keep sample sizes realistic. Target N=600 signups across the experiment over 2 weeks.
sam: I'll spin up the tracking plan. We need event names: `signup.source`, `starter_token.claimed`, `quickstart.completed`, `first_api_call`, `webinar.rsvp`. Also tag `lead.routing_bucket`.
maria: Nice. Olivia — can you confirm webhook tagging fields we can use? e.g., `utm_campaign`, `post_variant`, `token_channel` and `intent_score`?
olivia: Yes — we can push those. I'll add `prefers_demo` boolean from our intent classifier. We'll route: prefers_demo -> sales-assist queue, high-intent + region=NA -> webinar invite w/ seats, rest -> self-serve nurture.
kevin: For benchmark narrative content, can we use a short chart and DOM snippet in the post? We want something that highlights tokens-per-dollar and p95 latency.
maria: Draft copy idea: "Ship LLM features with consistent performance — real-world benchmarks showing 10-50% token-cost reduction with caching + routing". Short, with link to a one-slide benchmark.
sam: Onboarding prompt templates — two variants: A is a guided multi-step prompt, B is an open-ended starter that encourages exploration. Example A (dev-guided):
```
System: You are integrating Redwood Inference for a realtime chat.
User: Give me a starter prompt to implement streaming chat with cost-aware batching and a short checklist.
```
Example B (explorer):
```
System: You are a developer exploring Redwood's runtime.
User: Show me quick examples to call the API for text generation, embeddings, and a minimal web UI example.
```
maria: We'll gate quickstart.completed on the user running the provided snippet in the playground or the SDK within 7 days.
kevin: Reporting: Sam — can you add a dashboard slice: conversion by post_variant, token_channel, onboarding_template. Need cohort retention at day 1, 3, 7 and avg tokens used.
sam: Yep. I'll add a per-variant dashboard and a simple summary table. Also log `experiment.cell_id` on every relevant event.
olivia: Ops note — we should throttle the in-app modal so we don't overwhelm existing active users. Modal only for new signups and first session.
maria: Growth-bot — create experiment in Growth tracker, allocate users, and generate short UUID for the experiment.
growth-bot: Experiment created: EXP-3440011222. Allocation: 6 cells, 1:1:1:1:1:1. Tracking hooks: /webhooks/exp-3440011222 -> sends `cell_id`, `post_variant`, `token_channel`, `onboard_template`, `utm_campaign`.
kevin: Timeline? Need post copy + slide deck by EOD Fri, modal and webhook by Mon, dashboard + tracking by Tue. Webinar invite scheduled Wed next week.
maria: I'll own copy and webinar slides. Sam — you own dashboard. Olivia — you own routing. Kevin — can you review post copy and benchmark slide?
kevin: Yup. Reviewing by Thu 4pm.
sam: I'll wire the events and mock payloads. Example payload: `{ "user_id":"u123", "cell_id":"C3", "post_variant":"A", "token_channel":"modal" }` for the webhook.
olivia: I'll add routing rules in the router and create the demo queue.
maria: Quick risks: sample size could be lopsided if one channel drives social spikes. We'll monitor first 48h and pause if imbalance > 3x. Also watch for spammy webinar RSVPs — add email verification.
kevin: LGTM. Anything else?
sam: One more: tie a tiny qualitative survey for webinar attendees: 2 questions after webinar to capture whether the benchmark narrative matched their needs.
maria: Great. I'll draft the survey. Action items: Maria -> post + slides; Kevin -> review; Olivia -> webhook + routing; Sam -> tracking + dashboard; Growth-bot -> created. Meeting to sync Mon 10am. :calendar:
